question: Who is the author of 'Lords of Earth and Sea: A History of the Chola Empire', published in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anirudh Kanisetti**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The book titled **'Lords of Earth and Sea: A History of the Chola Empire'** is authored by the acclaimed historian and researcher **Anirudh Kanisetti**.
 
• Published in early **2025**, the book provides a deep dive into the **Chola dynasty**, one of the most powerful and influential empires in **South Indian** history.
 
• The narrative focuses on the **maritime prowess** of the Cholas, their sophisticated **administrative systems**, and their cultural impact that resonated across **Southeast Asia**.
 
• **Anirudh Kanisetti** is known for his ability to weave complex archaeological and epigraphic evidence into a compelling narrative for general readers.
 
• The book acts as a thematic successor to his highly successful debut work, **'Lords of the Deccan'**, which covered the history of medieval South India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Anirudh Kanisetti:**
 
 
• He is an **Indian historian** and researcher who has worked at various think tanks such as the **Takshashila Institution**.
 
• His first book, **'Lords of the Deccan: Southern India from the Chalukyas to the Cholas'**, was released in **2022** and won several accolades, including the **Tata Literature Live! First Book Award**.
 
• He is also well-known for his popular history podcasts, such as **'Echoes of India'** and **'Yuddha'**.
 
 
 
• **The Chola Empire:**
 
 
• The **Chola dynasty** flourished between the **9th and 13th centuries CE**, reaching its zenith under rulers like **Rajaraja Chola I** and his son **Rajendra Chola I**.
 
• They are famous for the construction of the **Brihadisvara Temple** in **Thanjavur**, which is a **UNESCO World Heritage Site**.
 
• Their **naval expeditions** led to the conquest of territories in the **Malay Archipelago** and parts of **Sri Lanka**.
 
 
 
• **Other Authors Mentioned:**
 
 
• **Shashi Tharoor:** A prominent **Indian politician** and diplomat, he has authored numerous books such as **'An Era of Darkness'** and **'The Paradoxical Prime Minister'**.
 
• **RK Narayan:** One of India's greatest novelists, famous for his fictional town **Malgudi** and books like **'Swami and Friends'** and **'The Guide'**.
 
• **KK Aziz:** A renowned **Pakistani historian** known for his critical analysis of history textbooks and works like **'The Murder of History'**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The year **2025** marks a significant period for historical non-fiction in India with the release of this detailed monograph on the **Cholas**.
 
• The book explores the transition from regional power to **transcontinental empire**, emphasizing the **Chola navy** as a primary tool for trade and military expansion.
 
• The **Chola administration** was pioneer in **local self-governance**, as evidenced by the **Uttiramerur inscriptions** detailing village council elections.
